name: filmcraft-web
description: FilmCraft non-linear video editor running in the browser via WebAssembly, WebGPU/WebGL2.

proxy.notes: Inspect child jobs for partial failures; wait:true is unsupported. Completed files consume browser memory.

maskTracking.notes: Pending media reads are retried. Project edits or replacement stop tracking; completed keyframes are retained.

exportRelease.note: Save files before releasing; active readers may retain memory and attached proxies may become unavailable.

videoPreviews.notes: Temporary rendering memory may exceed the shared audio/video cache budget.

audioPreviews.notes: Nested-sequence DSP with deferred reads has not been independently verified.

audioOutput.notes: Fallback runs on the main thread and may underrun under load; a user gesture may be required.

limitations: unsupported multichannel layouts and other nonstandard media are copied whole during consolidation
portableProject.notes: Sequences preserve gaps and isolate names. Each still-image read is limited to 256 MiB. Optional previews share a 256 MiB cache budget; older builds reject version 2 packages.

selection.sequences: existing sequence IDs; used for filtering when excludeUnused is true

consolidation.notes: Eligible video, mono/stereo audio, and labelled WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE 5.1 (0x3f, PCM 8/16/24 or float32) are re-encoded; unsupported media are copied whole.

exportMemory.notes: Seekable encoded exports avoid one growing WebAssembly buffer; browser memory is still used and Blob construction may copy. PNG and GIF use the existing path.

exportDestinations.notes: Direct OPFS exports cannot confirm durable writes and are rejected; save generated output explicitly.

persistentProjects.notes: Unique snapshots do not contain media or mark the project saved. Direct synchronous /opfs/ writes are refused.

diskExport.format: H.264/MP4, ProRes/MOV, DNxHR/MOV, APV/MOV, Motion JPEG/MOV, MXF OP1a, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, AAC/M4A
diskExport.notes: Queued output capped; total memory is not bounded. Inactive web.22 exports can be claimed with SHA-256 validation or explicitly deleted under Web Locks in the same persistent profile and origin. Legacy files excluded.

recovery.notes: Reload second tabs after owner closes and close/reload older web.20 tabs. Without Web Locks recovery is disabled; media may remain offline after interruption or quota failure. recoveryMediaStatus checks copy markers and sizes, not content hashes; image sequences skipped and copies are limited by browser quota and available storage.
